question: Show the number of stories of buildings in the region with name "Abruzzo".
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE buildings AS
WITH s AS (
  SELECT 
    building_id,
    name,
    address,
    completed_year,
    -- Derive candidate story counts by unpivoting the numeric columns
    -- We will take the maximum story count among non-null indicators per row
    GREATEST(
      CASE WHEN "1" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END,
      CASE WHEN "2" IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE NULL END,
      CASE WHEN "4" IS NOT NULL THEN 4 ELSE NULL END,
      CASE WHEN "5" IS NOT NULL THEN 5 ELSE NULL END,
      CASE WHEN "6" IS NOT NULL THEN 6 ELSE NULL END,
      CASE WHEN "8" IS NOT NULL THEN 8 ELSE NULL END,
      CASE WHEN "9" IS NOT NULL THEN 9 ELSE NULL END,
      CASE WHEN "10" IS NOT NULL THEN 10 ELSE NULL END
    ) AS stories
  FROM table_1
)
SELECT 
  CAST(building_id AS BIGINT) AS building_id,
  name,
  address,
  CAST(completed_year AS BIGINT) AS completed_year,
  CAST(stories AS BIGINT) AS stories,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS region_name
FROM s
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE regions AS
SELECT 
  CAST(region_id AS BIGINT) AS region_id,
  capital,
  CAST(area AS BIGINT) AS area,
  CAST(population AS BIGINT) AS population,
  TRIM(COALESCE(name_part1, '') || CASE WHEN name_part2 IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(name_part2)) > 0 THEN ' ' || TRIM(name_part2) ELSE '' END) AS name
FROM table_2

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT COALESCE(CAST(stories AS INTEGER), NULL) AS stories, COUNT(*) AS building_count
FROM buildings
WHERE region_name = 'Abruzzo'
GROUP BY stories
ORDER BY stories

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_regions AS
SELECT region_id,
       COALESCE(TRIM(name_part1 || ' ' || COALESCE(name_part2,'')), '') AS full_name,
       capital,
       area,
       population
FROM regions

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_regions AS
SELECT region_id, TRIM(name) AS full_name, capital, area, population
FROM regions

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_buildings_with_region AS
WITH cand AS (
  SELECT b.*, r.full_name, r.capital,
         CASE 
           WHEN r.full_name IS NOT NULL AND r.full_name <> '' AND LOWER(b.address) LIKE '%' || LOWER(r.full_name) || '%' THEN 2
           WHEN r.capital IS NOT NULL AND r.capital <> '' AND LOWER(b.address) LIKE '%' || LOWER(r.capital) || '%' THEN 1
           ELSE 0
         END AS match_score
  FROM buildings b
  CROSS JOIN tmp_regions r
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY building_id ORDER BY match_score DESC) AS rn
  FROM cand
)
SELECT building_id, name, address, completed_year, stories,
       CASE WHEN match_score > 0 THEN full_name ELSE NULL END AS region_name
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT CAST(stories AS INTEGER) AS stories, COUNT(*) AS building_count
FROM tmp_buildings_with_region
WHERE region_name = 'Abruzzo'
GROUP BY stories
ORDER BY stories

# Match buildings to regions via LIKE on full_name or capital

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_buildings_with_region AS
WITH cand AS (

         CASE 
           WHEN r.full_name IS NOT NULL AND r.full_name <> '' AND LOWER(b.address) LIKE '%' || LOWER(r.full_name) || '%' THEN 2
           WHEN r.capital IS NOT NULL AND r.capital <> '' AND LOWER(b.address) LIKE '%' || LOWER(r.capital) || '%' THEN 1
           ELSE 0
         END AS match_score
  FROM buildings b

), ranked AS (

)

       CASE WHEN match_score > 0 THEN full_name ELSE NULL END AS region_name
